concerns.text: Phase 0 (Environment & Lint) is not linked to any functional requirement (FR) or success criterion (SC) in the specification. While useful, it constitutes an over‑reach relative to the spec’s listed requirements.

Phase 7 (Orchestration & Verification) also lacks an explicit trace to any FR or SC. The spec does not mandate a dedicated orchestration phase, so this element is currently unanchored to the specification.
